newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran police kill eight smugglers, seize drugs.
newsitem.headline: Iran police kill eight smugglers, seize drugs.

text.p: Iranian police have killed eight traffickers and seized more than three tonnes of drugs in a two-week crackdown, Iran's news agency IRNA said on Wednesday.

It quoted Colonel Abbasali Rouhi, police chief of the southeastern Kerman province, as saying his forces killed eight armed smugglers, wounded another seven and seized 3,760 kg (8,270 lb) of drugs in the two-week operation which ended on Saturday.
Drug runners often use desert roads in Kerman to bring their goods from borders with Pakistan and Afghanistan -- the so-called "Golden Crescent".
Iran has an estimated one million drug addicts and is a key transit route for narcotics, mostly opium from which heroin is made, being smuggled to Europe via Turkey.
